identity: Two front-matter prefaces by a Syrian author of books on ancient Near Eastern history, myth and religion (Magharat al-'Aql al-Ula, Lughz Ishtar, Allah wa-l-Kawn wa-l-Insan). Part one, headed 'al-Kutub al-Iliktruniyya hibat al-'asr', is a foreword written for an electronic Hindawi edition; part two, headed 'Muqaddimat tab'at al-A'mal ghayr al-Kamila', introduces a collected-works edition. Register: first-person literary memoir in Modern Standard Arabic, reflective and periodic, with dates, book titles and publishing history woven into a life narrative. Structure: two headings, each followed by narrative paragraphs, plus a nine-token closing thanks line.
law: The sentence unit here is a completed predication followed by a NEW FRAME. Paragraph 3 (142-198) is the calibration case: zahara ... thumma ta'assasat ... allati la'ibat ... wa-waffarat ... fa-azahat ... wa-wasalathu is one unbroken 57-token relative-clause spine with no possible internal break, so this author's sentences genuinely run 20-57 tokens and must not be chopped at every clause. Corollary 1: fa- at the head of a clause is a WITHIN-sentence connector by default, proven internally by fa-ruhtu/fa-lam/fa-ta'akkadat in par.1, fa-azahat in par.3, fa-sadara and fa-lam ata'ajjal in par.8; it may open a new sentence only when it heads a large new block after an already-closed predication. Corollary 2: waw + finite verb continuing the SAME agent's action chain is a comma, not a period (aradtu ... wa-akhtartu; sharaftu ... wa-anjaztu). Corollary 3: a boundary is licensed when the waw/asyndetic clause carries a fronted frame-setting adverbial (ba'da dhalika, wa-li-radd al-jamil li-l-internet, wa-fi halat al-ta'ammul hadhihi, wa-fi kull mughamara, wa-'aman ba'da 'am), a presentative or emphatic opener (ha huwa, innahu, la-qad), or a pivot from narrative chronology to summative evaluation (wa-kana 'amal al-bahith, wa-kana najahan mudawwiyan akhar). Corollary 4: subordinators that cannot begin a sentence (ila an, allati, alladhi) block a boundary before them. Mean sentence length under this law is about 28 tokens, matching the observed rhythm.
